Anwar Rasheed Entertainment in association with Weekend Blockbusters presents Bangalore Days - A fun roller coaster ride about three young people who reach Bangalore to dream, discover & explore!
Writer/Director - Anjali Menon
Producers - Anwar Rasheed & Sophia Paul
Cinematographer - Sameer Thahir
Music Director - Gopi Sunder
Lyrics - Santhosh Varma
Singers - Vijay Yesudas,Sachin Warrier & Divya
Nadaswaram - Thrissur Gopi | Guitars Sumesh Parameswar | Bass Guitar - Josey | Keyboard programmed by Gopi Sunder
